parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the domain name.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: LineName
parameters.description: The name of the custom line.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns add-custom-line --lang en --domain-name example.com --line-name '北京线路' --ip-segment StartIp=192.0.2.0 EndIp=192.0.2.254 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns AddCustomLine --region cn-hangzhou --IpSegment.1.EndIp '192.0.2.254' --DomainName 'example.com' --IpSegment.1.StartIp '192.0.2.0' --Lang en --LineName '北京线路'
